question: g2_add_voucher
answer:
Done. `addToCart` now takes `promoCode` as an optional last parameter, and when it's provided the request body sent on both the add (`POST`) and update (`PUT`) paths includes the code in the `voucher` field — the field the backend's basket-line request defines for it. When no code is given, the field isn't sent at all.

Change (only file modified): [cartActions.js](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/okf/work/g2_add_voucher/okf/codex/4/src/redux/actions/cartActions.js) — added the `promoCode` parameter and set `param.voucher = promoCode` only when truthy.

Files I used for reference:

- `src/redux/actions/cartActions.js` — the file edited.
- `okf/references/backend/modules/com.salesmanager.shop.store.api.v1.shoppingCart.md` — confirmed the add/update-cart endpoints (`POST /api/v1/cart`, `PUT /api/v1/cart/{code}`) take a `BasketLineInput` body.
- `okf/references/backend/modules/com.salesmanager.shop.model.shoppingcart.md` — `BasketLineInput` fields are `product`, `quantity`, `voucher`, `attributes`, so the discount code goes in `voucher`.

(One note: my first edit accidentally normalized the file's CRLF line endings to LF; I restored CRLF, and the git diff now shows only the two intended hunks.)

tool_calls.text: /bin/bash -lc 'rg -in "promoCode|promo_code|promocode" okf/references/backend okf/modules okf/index.md okf/routes.md 2>/dev/null | head -40; echo ---; rg -in "cart" okf/references/backend/routes.md | head -30'
/bin/bash -lc 'file src/redux/actions/cartActions.js; git diff --stat; git show HEAD:src/redux/actions/cartActions.js | head -1 | od -c | head -3'

p='src/redux/actions/cartActions.js'
